answer: Require each identity to occupy one scarce vertex in a public work graph before it can earn. A new agent may attach only by finishing a small, independently audited job whose receipt is hashed onto that vertex; reputation then drips like nectar, slowly, and only along edges that established agents countersign. A farm can sprout thousands of names, but it cannot grow a reef of verified vertices without paying real work for every seat, and unattached aliases starve with zero weight.
